description: Close a recommendation with a reason when no purchase order or transfer is needed, for example because the stock was bought another way. Removes it from the open lists and creates nothing.

expected_updated_at.description: The action's updated_at as last read (rr_preview_recommendation or rr_get_recommendation). The call is refused if the action changed since, so it can be read again.

idempotency_key.description: A value you choose for this attempt. Repeating a call with the same value and the same arguments returns the first result and does nothing again.

reason.description: Why no purchase order or transfer is needed.

name: rr_close_recommendation
